$comment: D-PP-EMBED-ANGLE (C23 6.10.4.1p8), closed P60: runtime witness for the ANGLE form `#embed <blob.bin>` (plus `__has_embed(<...>)`'s three answers, 6.10.2p7), RUN on BOTH the baseline (debug) AND the `release` (shippedPipeline) arm. PROJECT MODE on purpose: the resource sits ONLY in `res/`, which `.dss-project.json` declares as an include directory (`includes`, the file-driven `-I`); the angle search covers the system directories and the include directories and never the including file's own directory, so nothing but that search can find `blob.bin`. blob.bin is 12 bytes (44 53 53 00 0D 0A 1A FE 7F 80 01 C3 -- NUL/CR/LF/SUB/0xFE canaries) and `suffix(, 0)` appends a terminating zero (6.10.4.3p2): 13 elements, each checked (exit 1..3 on a mismatch) before `sum & 0xFF` = 220 is returned through a runtime-opaque index. ⚠ NO REFERENCE COMPILER CAN COMPILE THIS FILE: gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3 and MSVC 19.51.36252 refuse `#embed` entirely (MEASURED 2026-09-04, each separately); the oracle is the ISO C23 text (N3220). The corpus target entries below MIRROR the project manifest's own `targets[]` (the runner cross-checks them) and carry the run-side facts (artifact name, runOn, emulator).
